tools.name: list_gaa_departments
tools.title: List GAA departments
tools.description: List all 38 departments in the enacted GAA (FY2020–2026) with per-year appropriations in pesos and line-item counts. Use this first to discover valid GAA department ids (two digits, e.g. '07').

tools.name: get_gaa_national_trends
tools.title: GAA national totals by year
tools.description: National GAA totals (pesos) and line-item counts for each fiscal year 2020–2026.

tools.name: get_gaa_department
tools.title: GAA department detail
tools.description: One GAA department: per-year totals, its agencies/bureaus (with ids usable as agency_id filters), and expense-class breakdown (PS / MOOE / FinEx / CO) across FY2020–2026. Amounts in pesos.

department_id.description: Two-digit GAA department id, e.g. '07' for DepEd

tools.name: search_gaa_programs
tools.title: Search GAA programs
tools.description: Search program/activity/project (P/A/P) families by name across all departments, or within one. Returns matches ranked by appropriation in the chosen year, with full FY2020–2026 histories. Good for questions like 'how much goes to school building programs?'.

query.description: Text to match against program names (min 2 chars)

department_id.description: Optional two-digit department id to scope the search

year.description: Fiscal year to rank/filter amounts by. One of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. Default 2026.

tools.name: get_gaa_department_programs
tools.title: GAA department programs (paginated)
tools.description: Program families for one department, largest first for the chosen year, with keyset pagination (pass next_cursor back as cursor). Also reports the matched total so partial pages still sum correctly.

year.description: Fiscal year to rank/filter amounts by. One of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. Default 2026.

query.description: Optional text filter on program name

agency_id.description: Optional agency id (from get_gaa_department) to scope to one bureau

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor

tools.name: search_gaa_line_items
tools.title: Search GAA line items
tools.description: UACS object-level line items for one department (the finest GAA granularity — up to ~1M rows for DepEd). Filter by text, agency, or expense class (1=PS, 2=MOOE, 3=FinEx, 6=CO); ranked by amount in the chosen year. Keyset paginated via cursor. Always scope tightly — this queries a 2M-row table.

query.description: Optional text filter on the line-item description or UACS code

year.description: Fiscal year to rank/filter amounts by. One of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. Default 2026.

agency_id.description: Optional agency id to scope to one bureau

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor

tools.name: get_gaa_year_snapshot
tools.title: GAA single-year snapshot
tools.description: One fiscal year in isolation: the national GAA total plus every department's appropriation, line-item count, and share of that year's budget, largest first. Use this when the question is about a specific year ('the 2022 budget') rather than trends across years.

tools.name: browse_gaa_hierarchy
tools.title: Browse GAA hierarchy for one year
tools.description: Walk one department's GAA hierarchy a level at a time, scoped to a single fiscal year: 'agencies' (bureaus — the default, no parent needed), then 'fpaps' of an agency (parent=<agency id>), 'operating_units' of a program, 'fund_subcategories' of an operating unit, and 'expenses' of a fund (the leaf). Rows carry that year's figures only, ranked largest first, with the parent-id columns needed to drill deeper; keyset paginated. Zero-amount rows are hidden unless include_zero is true.

department_id.description: Two-digit GAA department id, e.g. '07' for DepEd

parent.description: Parent entity id — required for every level below 'agencies'

include_zero.description: Include rows with a zero amount in the chosen year

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor

tools.name: get_nep_2027_overview
tools.title: NEP FY2027 national overview
tools.description: National view of the FY2027 National Expenditure Program (₱7.20T proposal): every department with its FY2027 proposed amount vs FY2026 GAA baseline (delta/pct), expense classes, regions, top funds, top programs, and biggest movers. Amounts in pesos.

tools.name: get_nep_2027_department
tools.title: NEP FY2027 department detail
tools.description: One department's FY2027 proposal vs FY2026 baseline: agencies, programs, expense classes, funds, regions, top objects/operating units/divisions (long tails capped with an explicit __other__ remainder), and top program movers. Ids: two digits, or synthetic 'SPF' / 'AUTO'. Use get_nep_2027_rollup for full long-tail lists.

department_id.description: NEP department id: two digits (e.g. '07'), 'SPF', or 'AUTO'

tools.name: get_nep_2027_rollup
tools.title: NEP FY2027 rollup by dimension
tools.description: Slice the FY2027 NEP by one dimension. Three modes: (1) no department_id/code — national totals per code in the dimension; (2) department_id set — the complete, untruncated list for that department (paginated); (3) code set with by_department=true — one code broken down across departments. Every dimension is complete (untagged rows bucket under '__unassigned__'), so sums reconcile to the ₱7.20T total.

code.description: With by_department=true, break this code down across departments (mode 3)

by_department.description: Set true with code for a cross-department breakdown

cursor.description: Opaque cursor (mode 2 only) from a previous next_cursor

tools.name: get_budget_cycle
tools.title: Budget cycle (NEP→GAA→execution)
tools.description: How appropriations moved through the budget cycle for one covered department: per program, per fiscal year (2018–2026), per stage (nep, gaa, authorized/adjusted appropriation, adjusted allotment, obligations, disbursements), per expense class (ps, mooe, finex, co, total). Coverage is limited to a handful of departments and to Current New Appropriations only — call without department_id first to see coverage.

department_id.description: Two-digit department id. Omit to get the coverage list and dataset manifest instead.

tools.name: list_nep_2027_departments
tools.title: List NEP FY2027 departments
tools.description: All 39 FY2027 NEP departments with proposed amount, FY2026 baseline, delta/pct, and per-dimension counts. Includes the synthetic 'SPF' and 'AUTO' departments.

tools.name: list_hearings
tools.title: List budget hearings
tools.description: House Committee on Appropriations budget hearings (YouTube streams), newest first: agency under review, date, length, whether a transcript and a per-topic deliberation record exist. Filter by fiscal_year (e.g. '2027'), agency acronym (e.g. 'DOH'), or a title keyword.

agency.description: Agency acronym as in the hearing title, e.g. 'DOH', 'DPWH'

query.description: Keyword matched against the hearing title

tools.name: search_hearings
tools.title: Search what was said in the hearings
tools.description: Search across every hearing's deliberation topics by keyword(s): returns the matching topic records (summary, agency position, outcome/status) plus the specific timestamped moments that mention the terms, each with a URL that opens the video there. All terms must match. Use this first for questions like 'what was said about flood control' or 'which hearings discussed unpaid health-worker benefits'.

query.description: One or more keywords, e.g. 'PhilHealth subsidy'

agency.description: Restrict to one agency's hearing(s), e.g. 'DOH'

status.description: Restrict to topics with this outcome status

tools.name: get_hearing
tools.title: Hearing overview and topic index
tools.description: One hearing: metadata (agency, date, length, YouTube and page URLs, transcript provenance) and its topic index — every deliberation topic with status, first timestamp, one-paragraph summary and outcome. Use get_hearing_topics for the full thread of each topic.

video_id.description: YouTube video id from list_hearings or search_hearings

tools.name: get_hearing_topics
tools.title: Full deliberation record by topic
tools.description: Every topic's full deliberation record for one hearing: question at issue, chronological thread of moments (timestamp, speaker, side, kind, what was said, url), agency position, members' positions, figures as spoken, actions (document requests, commitments, motions, rulings), outcome and status. Long hearings return 10–25 topics with up to 40 moments each; pass topic_index to fetch just one.

topic_index.description: 0-based index from get_hearing's topic list; omit for all topics

include_thread.description: false = summaries only, no moment-by-moment thread

tools.name: get_hearing_timeline
tools.title: Hearing timeline (section by section)
tools.description: The proceedings in order — roll call, agency presentation, each member's interpellation, motions, suspensions — with per-section summaries, question/answer exchanges, figures and actions, all timestamped and deep-linked. Use when the question is about the flow of the hearing rather than one topic.

tools.name: get_hearing_transcript
tools.title: Raw transcript window
tools.description: Machine transcript segments (with inferred speaker names) for a time window of one hearing — to read exactly what was said around a moment found via search_hearings or a topic thread. Default window is 20 minutes from from_seconds; at most 1000 segments.

tools.name: search_jurisprudence
tools.title: Search Supreme Court decisions
tools.description: Semantic search over Philippine Supreme Court decisions. Returns {results: [...]} with metadata, a snippet of the facts, and links; results is empty (with a note) when nothing sufficiently relevant matches. Use get_case with a result id for the full document.

query.description: Natural-language description of the legal question, facts, or doctrine

tools.name: search_republic_acts
tools.title: Search Republic Acts
tools.description: Semantic search over Philippine Republic Acts (legislation). Returns {results: [...]} with summaries and links; results is empty (with a note) when nothing sufficiently relevant matches. Use get_republic_act with a result id for the full document.

query.description: Natural-language description of the subject matter or policy area

tools.name: get_case
tools.title: Get a Supreme Court decision
tools.description: Fetch the full structured record of one decision: facts, procedural history, court reasoning, disposition, parties, cited rules. Provide either the id from a search result or a case number like "G.R. No. 254972".

id.description: Document id from a search result

include_full_text.description: Also return the complete decision text (can be long)

tools.name: get_republic_act
tools.title: Get a Republic Act
tools.description: Fetch the full structured record of one Republic Act. Provide either the id from a search result or an RA number like "RA 11313" or "11313".

id.description: Document id from a search result

include_full_text.description: Also return the complete act text (can be long)

tools.name: search_bills
tools.title: Semantic search for bills
tools.description: Search source-grounded bill analyses by meaning. Returns ranked House and Senate bills with summaries, authors, policy areas, keywords, and official source links.

query.description: A natural-language policy question, issue, or proposed intervention

tools.name: browse_bills
tools.title: Browse and filter bills
tools.description: Browse captured bill records using exact text and metadata filters. Use this for a bill number, title words, author name, committee, chamber, or the latest filed bills.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.title: Get a bill record
tools.description: Get one bill, its authors, status, committees, versions, official sources, and available source-grounded analyses. Provide a result id or a chamber and bill number.

id.description: Measure id returned by search_bills or browse_bills

bill_number.description: Bill number such as HB 1, HB00001, SBN 1981, or SBN-1981

include_text.description: Include extracted version text when it is available (responses can be long)

tools.name: search_authors
tools.title: Search bill authors
tools.description: Search captured House and Senate member profiles by name or representation. Returns profile ids, official profile links, bill counts, and BatasWatch profile URLs.

query.description: Author name, district, party-list, or representation

tools.name: get_author
tools.title: Get a bill author
tools.description: Fetch one House or Senate author profile by profile id or name. Optionally include the author's credited bills with participation roles and principal-author policy-focus and filing analytics.

tools.name: list_policy_areas
tools.title: List policy areas
tools.description: List the BatasWatch policy-area taxonomy with bill counts and leading principal authors.

tools.name: list_committees
tools.title: List legislative committees
tools.description: List House or Senate committees with captured bill referral counts and latest filing dates.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Read saved inventory coverage, freshness and query limits.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List statistical topics with dataset and explorable snapshot counts.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search PSA datasets by words, exact topic and snapshot availability. Results are paginated; use IDs from these results for other tools.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Get dataset metadata, dimension summaries, provenance and a one-point sampleQuery. Source-only datasets have no sampleQuery. Sample selections may still exceed the source-read budget.

tools.name: list_dimension_values
tools.description: Search and paginate accepted codes and labels for one dimension of a pinned release. Pass the exact dimension code, including punctuation. Use returned codes, not labels, in queries.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Read an exact selection from a complete mirrored snapshot. Supply its release and a nonempty code array for every dimension. Maximum 5,000 points, 64 chunks and 32 MiB source data. Null means missing, not zero. Cite source and release; verify units and definitions. No aggregation or live PSA requests.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List published ASEAN in Data datasets, columns, CSV downloads, checksums and coverage documents.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the 11 Southeast Asian countries and ISO3 codes.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Inspect a dataset schema and source documents before querying. Wide and long tables have different columns.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Read original dataset rows. Filters are exact, case-sensitive column/value matches combined with AND. Use iso3 for most datasets, recipient_iso3 for FDI. Strings and missing blanks are preserved. Paginate with next_offset. Do not sum incompatible FDI reporting bases.

tools.name: search_officials
tools.description: Find Philippine local politicians by surname or "Surname, First name". Returns ids to use with get_official. Results include runs, wins, active years and highest office.

province.description: Optional province name or slug to narrow the search

tools.name: get_official
tools.description: Full election record of one politician: every candidacy 2001-2025 with place, party, votes, rank, result and match confidence, plus the surname blocs they belong to.

tools.name: list_contests
tools.description: Races in a province or town, optionally for one year or position. Town queries include the district seats (representative, board member) the town votes in. Set candidates=true to include every candidate with votes and result.

position.description: governor, vice governor, representative, board member, mayor, vice mayor, councilor

tools.name: get_contest
tools.description: One race with all its candidates, votes, shares, winner(s), margin and, for district seats, the member towns. Give the contest id, or year + province + position with optional town and district.

tools.name: get_blocs
tools.description: Surname blocs: officials in one province who share a surname as last or middle name. This is the dynasty analysis. Filter by province or region, election year or "all", minimum members (rule), or surname. Shared surnames signal, not prove, kinship; say so when reporting.

tools.name: compare_elections
tools.description: Who held a seat across elections: the winners of one position in a province or town for every election, and who won it more than once. Answers "who keeps coming back" questions.

tools.name: get_national_results
tools.description: President, vice president, senate and party-list totals for an election year, nationally or for one province.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What the data covers per election and its known gaps (which years have votes, how people are matched). Check this before quoting numbers for 2001-2013.
